description: J/ψ = c̄c as a hyperbolic bound-state braid volume. Scale fixed on the proton Borromean mass-knot only. Tests whether a DERIVED c̄c+gluon braid predicts the OBSERVABLE J/ψ (3096.9) / η_c (2983.9); reports entropy and the J/ψ↔η_c single-braid discriminator. Anti-fit (PR #1805).

precision.chern_simons_ceiling_note: SnapPy's chern_simons() takes no bits_prec; the only high-precision route is high_precision() (ManifoldHP), fixed at 212 bits (~63 decimal digits). CS precision therefore does NOT track QOU_COMPUTE_DPS — digits beyond ~63 are not real.
precision.serialization: All geometric quantities are mpmath.mpf serialized as decimal strings via _precision.fmt at the canonical output precision. No float64 enters this witness (AGENTS.md precision discipline).

best_braid_etac.chern_simons_zero_note: Exactly 0 — the raw SnapPy value is triangulation noise at ~1e-64 and varies per run; the braid is amphichiral.

assertions.name: jpsi_not_in_proton_borromean_family
assertions.source: J/ψ (3097) falls strictly between winding k=6 (2770. MeV) and k=7 (3336. MeV): the proton's own Borromean family contains no integer-winding J/ψ.

assertions.name: jpsi_etac_best_fit_by_different_braids
assertions.source: The nearly-degenerate c̄c pair (3.7% split) is best-fit by different-topology braids — a per-state fitting signature, not a single derived c̄c bound-state object.

assertions.name: jpsi_scale_in_range_not_volume_excluded
assertions.source: Unlike the neutrino (scope-(b) volume-excluded), the J/ψ mass scale is reachable: hyperbolic braids with Vol≈24 give ≈3097 MeV. The mechanism is not excluded; the braid is undefined.

verdict: SHARPENED NEGATIVE. J/ψ is IN-RANGE for the hyperbolic bound-state mass mechanism (positive: distinguishes it from the neutrino's scope-(b) exclusion), but NO parameter-free c̄c braid is derived. Evidence it is a fit, not a derivation: (i) the proton's own (σ₁σ₂⁻¹)^k family misses J/ψ at every integer k (k=6→2770, k=7→3336); (ii) the volume spectrum near the target is dense (4.08% of simple braids — 8 of 196 — land in the 279.5-MeV band); (iii) J/ψ and η_c — the same c̄c system split by only 3.7% hyperfine — are best-fit by DIFFERENT braid topologies, the classic per-state-fit signature. The precise open wall: 'thread c̄c through the gluon T(2,9) color tube' is topologically under-defined (many inequivalent satellite/cable/threading operations → no unique volume). m_c/J/ψ stays OPEN; the volume-density mechanism CLASS is confirmed in-range but the braid remains underived.
scope: (a) scope-limited negative: no derived braid found; mechanism in-range.
